info.name: Dash0 Manage Teams and Members API
info.description:
## Selecting a dataset

Endpoints that operate on a single dataset take it from the `dataset` query parameter, or from the `Dash0-Dataset` request header when the query parameter is absent. When both are present the query parameter wins.

If neither is given, the request falls back to the organization's `default` dataset — a token that is restricted to specific datasets is rejected with `403 Forbidden` in that case, so always select a dataset explicitly when using a dataset-restricted token.

## Resource origins

Most resources take an optional `metadata.labels["dash0.com/origin"]`. It is a stable identifier you choose for a resource you manage as code, so your Terraform configuration, Kubernetes manifests, CLI scripts or your own tooling can address the same resource on every apply without having to store the id Dash0 generated.

An origin is unique per organization, not per dataset. Two resources of the same type in one organization cannot share an origin, even when they live in different datasets. If you want what is really the same rule in several datasets, put the dataset in the origin, for example `probabilistic-request-sampling-sandbox` and `probabilistic-request-sampling-nonprod`. The Dash0 Kubernetes operator does the same with the origins it generates. A duplicate origin is rejected with `400`.

You cannot change an origin. Dash0 records it when the resource is created and ignores it on later updates, so you can read a resource, edit it and send it back without stripping the label out first.

Endpoints with an `{originOrId}` path parameter take either identifier. A value that is not a UUID is read as an origin. A `PUT` to an origin that does not exist yet creates the resource with that origin, so you can apply the same manifest repeatedly.

## Request body size limit

Most API endpoints enforce a maximum request body size of 256KB. Bulk
endpoints accept a larger body size per request to accommodate batched
payloads.

Requests exceeding the applicable limit are rejected with a
`413 Content Too Large` response.

variable.description:
(Required) ID of the invitation to revoke, as returned in `metadata.labels['dash0.com/id']` by
`GET /api/members/invitations`. An invitation that does not exist, or that was already
accepted, revoked or expired, is rejected with `404`.

request.description:
Revokes an invitation to your organization that has not been accepted yet, so it can no
longer be accepted. Requires the admin role.

item.name: Receive a list of pending member invitations

request.description:
Receive all invitations to your organization that have not been accepted yet. Invitees are
not listed by `GET /api/members` until they accept, so compare against both lists before
inviting an address again. Requires the admin role.

response.name: Receive a list of pending invitations.

item.name: Change the organization role of a member

variable.description: (Required) The internal ID of the member whose role to change.

request.description: Changes the role of a member of your organization.

item.name: Remove a member from the organization

variable.description: (Required) The internal ID of the member to remove.

request.description: Removes the given member from the organization.

item.name: Receive a list of organization members

request.description: Receive a list of all members in your organization.

item.name: Invite a member to the organization

request.description: Sends an invitation to join the organization to the given email address.

item.name: Update a specific team display option

request.description: Update the display name, description, and color of a team.

item.name: Remove a member from a team

request.description: Removes the given member from the team.
Adds the given members to the team.

item.name: Delete a specific team by its origin or id

request.description: Delete a specific team by its **origin** or **id**.

item.name: Receive a specific team by its origin or id

request.description: Receive a specific team by its **origin** or **id**.

item.name: Update or insert a specific team by its origin or id

request.description:
Update or insert a specific team by its **origin** or **id**. In case a team with the given **origin** or **id** is found it will be updated. If there is no team found a new team will be created and the given `originOrId` is used as **origin**.

`spec.display` fully replaces the existing display values. `spec.members` is reconciled declaratively — the resulting membership is exactly the set given in the request body (adds and removes are computed against the current membership).
Receive a list of your organization teams
Create a new team in the organization.
